name: voice-shopping-assistant
description: Voice-controlled shopping assistant with deterministic NLU, Turso libSQL, and responsive Voice UI

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix shared run build && npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix server run test && npm --prefix client run test
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix shared run build && npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
scripts.build:client: npm --prefix shared run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.deploy:firebase: npm run build && npx -p firebase-tools firebase deploy --only hosting
